StudyNote.title: StudyNote
StudyNote.description: A scholarly study note, Kitab Ibarat explanation, translation, or Da'wa outline saved by a student.

uid.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this study note.

studentId.description: The ICS Academy student identifier (e.g., st-101).

mode.description: The AI research mode used to generate the note.

language.description: The primary output language of the note.

prompt.description: The student's question or Kitab passage.

response.description: The AI-generated scholarly explanation or study outline.

createdAt.description: The server timestamp when the note was created.

LeaveRecord.title: LeaveRecord
LeaveRecord.description: A student leave registration or return registry entry stored in Firestore.

uid.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who submitted the record.

studentName.description: The full name of the student.

recordType.description: Whether this entry is a leave application or return registration.

dateString.description: Formatted date of departure or return (e.g., 29 Oct 2026).

timeString.description: Formatted 12-hour time of departure or return (e.g., 09:00 AM).

reason.description: The selected reason for leave or return note.

details.description: Additional details when reason is Other.

createdAt.description: The server timestamp when the record was submitted.

DigitalKitab.title: DigitalKitab
DigitalKitab.description: An academic Kitab or scholarly PDF stored in Firebase Storage and indexed in the Student Dashboard Digital Library.

uid.description: The authenticated user or student portal session UID that registered or synced the Kitab.

title.description: The transliterated or English title of the academic Kitab.

arabicTitle.description: The original Arabic title of the Kitab.

author.description: The classical or contemporary scholar who authored the Kitab.

category.description: The academic subject category of the Kitab.

classBatch.description: Target Da'wa College class or batch (e.g., S1 Da'wa, S2 Da'wa, S3 Da'wa, General Reference).

language.description: Primary language(s) of the PDF edition.

pages.description: Total page count of the PDF volume.

pdfUrl.description: Resolved Firebase Storage download URL or fallback URL for the PDF.

summary.description: Concise syllabus description and scholarly overview of the Kitab.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Kitab entry was indexed.

/studyNotes/{noteId}.description: Stores scholarly AI study notes and Kitab research saved by students.

/leaveRecords/{recordId}.description: Stores student leave applications and campus return registry records.

/digitalKitabs/{kitabId}.description: Stores metadata and Firebase Storage paths for academic Kitabs and PDFs in the Digital Library.
